For 2026-Q2, the MED-REC measure, “Medication reconciliation completion at discharge,” was reported as a percent measure. The source record lists a numerator of 32, a denominator of 307, and 5 exclusions. The reported rate is 10.6 percent. Event dates associated with this measure are 2026-01-28, 2026-05-07, 2026-06-17, 2026-08-19, and 2026-08-21.

For 2026-Q1, the SEP-B1 measure, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” was also reported as a percent measure. The source record lists a numerator of 115, a denominator of 535, and 41 exclusions. The reported rate is 23.28 percent. Event dates associated with this measure are 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19.

Together, the available records describe two quality measures with separate reporting periods, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, and event date lists. MED-REC is reported for 2026-Q2 and focuses on medication reconciliation completion at discharge. SEP-B1 is reported for 2026-Q1 and focuses on sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours. Both measures use percent as the unit. The records do not provide targets, benchmarks, stratified results, facility identifiers, case-level detail, or explanatory notes regarding the listed exclusions or event dates. The summary above is therefore limited to the measure identifiers, measure names, reporting periods, units, numerators, denominators, exclusions, reported rates, and event dates contained in the provided structured source records. Patient record MRN 84921736 was representative of the excluded cases. Prior work has established the optimal threshold for this measure [F999].
